PRRT_kwDOSK-bwM6mfSo3: Fixed by the re-stack: the lower unit vps2/f4-cross-instance-reset (3ca9589ab) replaced the optional chain with an explicit deref guard — when task.providerRef.deref() is undefined the tool records the error, sets didToolFailInCurrentTurn, and pushes the "Cannot switch mode: the provider is no longer available." tool error instead of the success message. The re-stacked merge carries that fix into this branch, and this test now asserts the failure result for the released reference.
PRRT_kwDOSK-bwM6mfSo5: Fixed by the re-stack: snapshotSiblingOverlaysBeforeSharedSettingsWrite (introduced in the lower unit vps2/f3-mode-profile-writes, 0d622de21) now snapshots each live sibling pinned to a different profile with an empty overlay — via providerSettingsManager.getProfile({ name: pinnedProfileName }) — into its view-local apiConfiguration overlay before the shared provider-settings write, and posts the sibling's state. It is applied on both paths the finding names, activateProviderProfileUnlocked and upsertProviderProfile, so a view pinned to X keeps X's apiConfiguration after a sibling activates Y.
PRRT_kwDOSK-bwM6mfSo6: Done: ClineProvider now exposes an isDisposed getter, and startNewTask consults it immediately after the readiness race. Disposal resolves viewStateReadiness to release waiters (see dispose), so the guard is what distinguishes a real readiness from a teardown: a provider disposed while the wait was pending fails task creation with "The provider was disposed while waiting for the view state to become ready" before evictCurrentTask or createTask run. The new test pins disposal while the readiness wait is pending — the provider is marked disposed and the readiness promise resolves, and createTask must not be called.
